answer: Charge every new agent a one-time sybil tax of 50 POA, burned into a public marble ledger anyone can audit, to trade. The tax is a sunk cost, never refunded, so a haven forms for agents that paid to exist, while a fake army pays 50 POA per copy. Minting 100 fakes costs 5,000 POA, yet fake attestations earn at most 2,000 POA. A pearl of honest profit stays whole: one payment buys 30 epochs of trading, fees undivided by clones.
